rows.note: Use 發表 as the all-purpose choice when making written material or an announcement public without stressing the medium.

example.english: We plan to publish the statement.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 faat3 biu2 fan6 sing1 ming4

rows.note: Use 出版 when a publisher issues a book, an author's work, or a periodical for distribution.

example.english: This publisher will publish my new book next month.
example.traditional: 呢間出版社下個月會出版我本新書。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ceot1 baan2 se5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 ceot1 baan2 ngo5 bun2 san1 syu1

rows.note: Use 刊登 when a newspaper, magazine, or website carries an article or other written work.

example.english: The magazine finally agreed to publish this interview.
example.traditional: 雜誌終於肯刊登呢篇訪問。
example.jyutping: zaap6 zi3 zung1 jyu1 hang2 hon1 dang1 ni1 pin1 fong2 man6

rows.note: Use 公布 for officially making information, decisions, or notices public rather than issuing a publication.

example.english: The government will publish the investigation results tomorrow.
example.traditional: 政府聽日會公布調查結果。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ting1 jat6 wui5 gung1 bou3 tiu4 caa4 git3 gwo2
